_howto: Sites polled by the ResultsAjax.svc ENR adapter (server/src/adapters/resultsajax.js): the ASP.NET results sites OR, NM, NE and SD share. site = the public results site; serviceRoot = the page's `var ServiceRoot` (view source); svc = the service file (NM: NMResultsAjax.svc). categories = the `type` of every resultsSW.aspx?type=...&map=CTY link on the site's home page (each contest on those pages is stored). detailTypes = categories re-read on every turnout change (federal / statewide offices and statewide measures); every other contest is swept at most sweepBatch per poll, a new sweep at most every sweepSeconds. zeroOsn: the site's own BuildCounties.js sends osn=0 for general elections (OR). enabled:false parks a site. electionDate = the site's hidElectionDate field for this election: nothing is stored while the site shows another election.

sites.name: North Dakota 2026 General Election
